name: Cave Nitre
notes: White crust scraped from deep, dry rock. The heart of any blast powder.

name: Hollowreed Seed
notes: Hard little seeds from reeds along tarn edges. Steeped and sprouted, they ferment readily.

name: Bramblesweet
notes: Dark, sticky clusters from a thorny mountain bramble. Too sweet to eat many of; perfect for fermenting.

name: Cloudwasp Comb
notes: Pale wax comb from the nests of high-altitude wasps, heavy with golden syrup. Harvest it fast.

name: Grave Salt
notes: Grave Silt boiled down to grey crystals. Brainless will not cross a line of it willingly.

name: Bone Meal
notes: Ground bone and tooth. A binding and warding base.

name: Distilled Breath-Black
notes: Breath-black bile reduced to an ink-dark concentrate.

name: Iron Ingot
notes: A bar of smelted iron.

name: Rimecopper Ingot
notes: A cold, pale copper bar.

name: Thornspine Silver Ingot
notes: Bright silver from the Thornspine veins. Undead flesh burns where it touches.

name: Cut Emberquartz
notes: Emberquartz cut and polished to focus its warmth.

name: Whetstone Paste
notes: Slate grit bound in oil. Puts a hard edge on anything.

name: Wood Planks
notes: Cut and dried planks.

name: Ironbark Planks
notes: Ironbark cut into heavy planks.

name: Pitch Binder
notes: Pine pitch cooked into a waterproof, flammable binder.

name: Ashwood Haft
notes: An ashwood billet shaped into a flexible haft or limb.

name: Bitterleaf Extract
notes: A strong bitterleaf infusion. The base of most field remedies.

name: Moss Wadding
notes: Dried, pressed crag moss for packing wounds.

name: Hollowcap Toxin
notes: A clear, odourless toxin from boiled hollowcap.

name: Graveroot Tincture
notes: Graveroot steeped in spirit. Smells of turned earth.

name: Thistle Salve Base
notes: A soothing silver salve made from pale thistle sap.

name: Emberleaf Oil
notes: A red oil pressed from emberleaf. It warms the skin and burns bright.

name: Fish Oil
notes: Clear rendered oil. Burns long and clean.

name: Fish Glue
notes: Strong glue boiled from mudwhip skin.

name: Glassjaw Scales
notes: Cleaned, hardened glassjaw scales ready for stitching.

name: Cured Wolf Leather
notes: Wolf pelt cured into tough, warm leather.

name: Supple Stag Leather
notes: Soft, strong leather from tanned stag hide.

name: Cured Winter Fur
notes: Winter pelt cured with the fur on. Very warm.

name: Tanned Bear Hide
notes: A whole bear hide tanned thick. Heavy, but turns blades.

name: Rendered Tallow
notes: Bear fat rendered clean. Waterproofs, fuels and soothes.

name: Star-Iron Ingot
notes: Meteoric iron worked into a bar. Blades made from it hit harder than their weight.

name: Meteoric Flux
notes: Ground skyfall slag. A pinch lets star-iron bond with ordinary metal.

name: Charcoal
notes: Pine burned slow and airless. Fuel, filter and a third of every blast powder.

name: Blast Powder
notes: Grey-black powder that goes up with a flash and a bang. Keep it dry and far from flame.

name: Fuse Cord
notes: Pitch-soaked cord packed with powder. Burns about a foot every few seconds.

name: Hollowreed Mash
notes: Sprouted, crushed hollowreed seed left to sour. The base of most brews.

name: Distilled Alcohol
notes: Clear, harsh spirit run off a still. Drinkable in a pinch; mostly used by alchemists.
